claims.statement: After one parity-balanced activation, an arbitrary-depth tower using fresh two-bit AND balancers of mean -1/2 satisfies G(F_d)<=2^{-d}G(P)+24 and transfers every base GU' inequality to G(F_d)<=(a+24)I(F_d)+bU(F_d), preserving b<1 exactly.
For the same tower, every base endpoint U(P)<=cI(P) with c>=72/35 propagates to all depths, hence H(F_d)<=(2+2c)I(F_d).
No dimension-independent aggregate control is proved for arbitrary balancer bias, biased outer selectors, overlap, variable reuse, or changing coherent cores.
